conventions.qubit_indexing: Little-endian: state |q0 q1 ... q_{n-1}> has index sum(q_k * 2^k). Qubit 0 is the least significant bit.

gate_definitions.CNOT: Controlled-NOT: flips target qubit when control qubit is |1>. Quil syntax: CNOT control target.
gate_definitions.CZ: Controlled-Z: applies phase -1 when both qubits are |1>. Quil syntax: CZ q1 q2.

conventions.pauli_strings: In a Pauli string like 'XZIY', the k-th character (0-indexed) is the Pauli operator acting on qubit k. The full operator is the tensor product P_{n-1} x ... x P_1 x P_0.

circuit_format: All circuits are Quil program files (.quil) in /app/circuits/. Each line contains one gate instruction: GATE qubit, GATE(param) qubit, or GATE qubit1 qubit2. Lines starting with # are comments. Empty lines are ignored.

tasks.description: Parse the Quil program and simulate the circuit starting from the all-zeros state |0000>. Report the final 2^4 = 16 complex amplitudes.

format.state_vector: List of 16 pairs [real_part, imaginary_part], indexed 0 through 15.

tasks.description: For each circuit, simulate it from |0...0> to obtain a computational basis state |j>. Then apply the N-point unitary matrix F defined by F_{k,j} = exp(2*pi*i*j*k/N) / sqrt(N) where N = 2^num_qubits. Report the transformed state vector for each input.

format.outputs: List of 3 state vectors, each a list of [real, imaginary] pairs.

tasks.description: Simulate each circuit from |0...0> to get state |psi>. Form rho = |psi><psi|, then obtain the reduced state rho_A for the qubits listed in subsystem_A by eliminating the remaining qubits. Compute S = -sum over non-zero eigenvalues lambda_k of (lambda_k * ln(lambda_k)), using the natural logarithm.

Construct the 2^n x 2^n matrix H = sum_j c_j * P_j where each P_j is a tensor product of single-qubit Pauli matrices as specified by the pauli string. Report the algebraically smallest eigenvalue of H. Then simulate the initial state circuit from |0...0> to get |psi(0)>, apply the matrix exp(-i*H*t) for the given time t to get |psi(t)>, and report the real value <psi(t)|O|psi(t)> where O is the observable matrix.

Extract all unique pairs of qubits that interact via two-qubit gates in the Quil circuit (the interaction graph). Parse the hardware connectivity from the GraphViz DOT file (the topology graph). Report: interaction_edges (count of unique interacting qubit pairs), topology_edges (count of hardware connections), compatible_edges (count of interaction edges present in the topology), and directly_executable (true iff every interaction edge exists in the topology). Additionally, write the interaction graph as a valid GraphViz DOT file to /app/graphs/interaction_circuit_a.dot with nodes for each qubit and undirected edges for each interacting pair.

format.interaction_graph_file: String: path to the generated DOT file.
